shared_principle_description: Ashwagandha (horse smell) restores vitality like the horse yoni of Ashwini
Shatavari shares Shatabhisha nakshatra with horse yoni
Banana shares earth element and Jupiter rulership with elephant
Lotus and elephant share auspicious Jupiter quality in Revati
Fire grasses share Krittika solar fire with sacrificial sheep
Kusha grass and sheep both central to Vedic yajna
Neem cools serpent fire; both share Rahu and water element
Nagakesara (serpent-stamen) is traditionally paired with Naga/Sarpa
Tulsi and dog both bear Ketu transformative quality at Mula
Calotropis (arka) shares Ardra fierce energy with dog yoni
Brahmi and cat share lunar water sattva at Punarvasu
Jasmine and cat share Venus refinement and nocturnal quality
Durva grass and mouse share Mercury earth quality; both sacred to Ganesha
Palasha shares Purva Phalguni creative earth energy with mouse
Tulsi and cow are both supreme sattvic beings in Vaishnava tradition
Darbha grass and cow both essential to dharmic ritual
Lotus and buffalo share water endurance; Durga stands on buffalo near lotus
Vetiver shares Swati water grounding with buffalo
Bilva and tiger share Mars fire; both sacred to Shiva
Red sandalwood and tiger share Mars sovereign fire quality
Sandalwood and rabbit share gentle lunar air quality
Jasmine and rabbit share Venus devotional gentleness
Amla and monkey share Mercury air intelligence
Banana shares Shravana with monkey; Hanuman fond of banana
Turmeric and mongoose both antidotes to serpent venom
Sunflower and lion share solar fire sovereignty
Palasha flame-of-forest shares fierce fire with lion
Peacock eats serpents; neem purifies serpent poison
Swan discriminates milk from water as lotus rises from mud
Garuda carries amrita; serpent-enemy brings immortal nectar
Nandi and bilva both sacred to Shiva; earth-sattva pair
Owl and ashoka tree share Saturn patience in darkness
Parrot perches in mango; both symbols of Kamadeva desire
Makara guards gateway as lotus emerges from water
Airavata draws water that becomes rain; lotus receives rain
